messages:
arjun: FYI running into a cross-sdk embedding mismatch while demoing the retriever. node returns 2048-d, python returns 1024 for the same model alias. also seeing duplicate batch submits when the auth token expires mid-send.

lea: ugh. do you have exact SDK versions + model string? sometimes aliasing maps to different variants under pressure.

arjun: node@1.5.0, python@1.0.2, model='open-redwood-embed-large' (same literal in both). verified shapes before any client-side postprocessing.

noah: pinging eng-runtime + infra. possible causes: (1) routing fallback to a quantized/shorter-dim variant when load spikes, (2) SDK batching not deduping after auth-refresh-retry.

arjun: here's a short log snippet showing the resend:
```
batcher: queued batch uid=bf3c send_count=1
http: 401 unauthorized -> refreshing token
batcher: requeue batch uid=bf3c send_count=2
http: 200 OK
batcher: sent batch uid=bf3c send_count=2
```

arjun: sample outputs:
- node: [[...], ...] shape [3,2048]
- python: [[...], ...] shape [3,1024]

lea: SDK parity issue: node exposes batch_uid in the wire payload metadata; python didn't include it until the last release. that makes client-level dedupe harder. opening a python SDK PR to attach client_batch_id on outgoing batches.

noah: runtime note: we have a fallback policy that will serve smaller-dim variants when memory constrained. currently we match by model family name only; we do not assert vector_dim equality. that could lead to downstream breaks.

arjun: for the demo i patched the retriever to assert dims and throw if mismatch. quick workaround is to normalize vectors (pad/truncate) but that's risky for quality. throwing is better for now.

lea: ops-bot can we surface a response header like X-Vector-Dim to make mismatches explicit? even a warning header would help DX.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-4892 for response header + routing strictness toggle. assigned to eng-runtime.

noah: plan of record: (a) add X-Vector-Dim response header and variant-dim check in routing, (b) make SDK batching idempotent by honoring client_batch_id across retry attempts, (c) audit all sampleapps for implicit assumptions about dim equality.

arjun: +1. i'll push a sampleapp change that fails loudly if dims differ and include a short README note. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/pull/548

lea: i'll land the python SDK PR to attach client_batch_id and add a small unit test around token expiry+retry to assert single send.

noah: tagging @infra for telemetry: we should count how often fallback->retry pairs happen per minute so we can see impact on batch duplication.

arjun: thanks folks. once python SDK & runtime header land i'll re-run the demo and update the onboarding guide.

sdk-bot: smoke test pass queued for sampleapp multi-sdk embed parity.
